scope: Twelve daily activity hairstyle sources explicitly bound to sixteen poses; private review only

records.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
EDIT IMAGE 1 IN PLACE. It is the correctly registered hair-only cap for Solar Friends daily-activity pose 0, on a mostly empty 1254×1254 transparent canvas. Preserve its exact small location, head angle, scale and ear opening. Its current painted bounds are x581–845, y103–282; keep approximately that same compact footprint, without moving, enlarging or recentering it.
Change ONLY the curly hair structure into the chestnut SIDE-PART hairstyle shown in image 2. Image 2 is hairstyle and paint identity ONLY: never copy its canvas coordinates or its silhouette size. Replace the round curl clusters with two or three broad gently swept painted groups, a subtle side part, low crown, close sides, warm chestnut colour and restrained upper-left brush highlights. Keep image 1's head orientation and footprint even though image 2 has a different pose.
Return a 1254×1254 true-transparent HAIR-ONLY PNG. Keep all transparent margin empty; the small hair cap is the only painted subject. No face, skin, ear, eyebrow, head-shaped opaque backing, body, hands, utensils, plants, stools, ground, shadow, guide, text or background. No stretching, resizing, warping or independent fitting of a cap; repaint at the original image-1 registration. No curls, tall quiff, glossy plastic or individual strand noise.

references.role: Pose registration edit target; preserve position, orientation, canvas and compact footprint
Side-part chestnut paint and shape identity only, not coordinates

records.verdict: Accepted into private pose/equipment review, not approved for production
records.rawReview: Broad warm chestnut swept groups replace curls. Transparent hair-only output, compact pose-aligned location. Body contact and temporal volume still require composed review.
records.composedReview: Inspected all four activity palette boards, both facings/day-night timelines and decoded public-button recordings. Eyes and ear apertures remain readable; no obvious scalp gap or hair/tool overlap in these views. Crown compression and rear sweep vary somewhat between head tilts; final temporal consistency remains open.
